blocks.text: The Fréscopa Atelier learns what you love, softens or sharpens to match your mood, and reorders beans before you run out. Barista craft, kept warm by a little intelligence.
It reads the room. And the calendar.
Whether it's a 9am seminar or a 2am essay crunch, the Atelier senses time, reads your calendar, even checks the weather—so every cup is dialed to the moment.
Compostable pods. Plastic-free refills. Self-reordering when you're low. Grounds go to the garden, not the landfill.
Every Atelier begins at the Fréscopa Café
Pull a shot on the machine before you buy it. Sample our seasonal blends. Find a café near you.

Adapts to individual taste preferences over approximately 7 days. Supports up to 6 household member profiles. Creates personalized 'flavour DNA' per user.
Ring of sensors monitors every extraction. Reads grind size, water flow, cup strength, and group head temperature. Whisper-quiet grinding at 58 dB.
Analyzes time of day, calendar events, weather, and household activity. Automatically warms up before alarms. Adjusts brewing parameters based on morning type.
Dimensions: 32 × 24 × 41 cm. Weight: 9.8 kg. Materials: Anodised aluminium with oak trim. Water tank: 1.8 L. Bean hopper: 250 g. Pump pressure: 15 bar.
Connectivity: Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz, Bluetooth 5.0. Compatible with iOS 15+ and Android 10+. Energy rating: A+.
